description: This file provides PHP4 session management using the ADODB database abstraction layer, including functions for session open, close, read, write, destroy, and garbage collection, specifically tailored for database-backed sessions. It also contains setup instructions, connection handling, and example usage comments.

methods.name: adodb_session_regenerate_id
methods.description: Regenerates the session ID by updating the session key in the database and resetting the cookie.

methods.name: adodb_sess_open
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database for session management, supporting persistent and non-persistent connections.

methods.name: adodb_sess_close
methods.description: Closes the database connection used for session management.

methods.name: adodb_sess_read
methods.description: Reads session data from the database based on the session key.

methods.name: adodb_sess_write
methods.description: Writes session data into the database, optimizing updates using CRC checks.

methods.name: adodb_sess_destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data from the database for a given session key, optionally calling a notification callback.

methods.name: adodb_sess_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection to delete expired sessions from the database.
